audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Exodus / Shemot renewed covenant text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for renewed tablets, YHWH character proclamation, covenant renewal, anti-idolatry commands, festivals, Moses' forty days, shining face.

verses.restored: YHWH said to Moses, Carve for yourself two tablets of stone like the first, and I will write upon tablets the words that were on first tablets, which you shattered.

familiar.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first: and I will write upon these tables the words that were in the first tables, which thou brakest.

modern.text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Chisel out two stone tablets like the originals, and I will write on them the words that were on the first tablets, which you broke.

original.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֔ה פְּסָל לְךָ֛ שְׁנֵֽי לֻחֹ֥ת אֲבָנִ֖ים כָּרִאשֹׁנִ֑ים וְכָתַבְתִּי֙ עַל הַלֻּחֹ֔ת אֶת הַדְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָי֛וּ עַל הַלֻּחֹ֥ת הָרִאשֹׁנִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר שִׁבַּֽרְתָּ

verses.restored: Be ready for morning, and come up in morning to Mount Sinai; station yourself there for me on top of mountain.

familiar.text: And be ready in the morning, and come up in the morning unto mount Sinai, and present thyself there to me in the top of the mount.

modern.text: Be ready in the morning, and come up on Mount Sinai to present yourself before Me on the mountaintop.

original.text: וֶהְיֵ֥ה נָכ֖וֹן לַבֹּ֑קֶר וְעָלִ֤יתָ בַבֹּ֨קֶר֙ אֶל הַ֣ר סִינַ֔י וְנִצַּבְתָּ֥ לִ֛י שָׁ֖ם עַל רֹ֥אשׁ הָהָֽר

verses.restored: No man shall come up with you, and also no man shall be seen in all mountain; even flock and herd shall not graze before that mountain.

familiar.text: And no man shall come up with thee, neither let any man be seen throughout all the mount; neither let the flocks nor herds feed before that mount.

modern.text: No one may go up with you; in fact, no one may be seen anywhere on the mountain—not even the flocks or herds may graze in front of the mountain.”

original.text: וְאִישׁ֙ לֹֽא יַעֲלֶ֣ה עִמָּ֔ךְ וְגַם אִ֥ישׁ אַל יֵרָ֖א בְּכָל הָהָ֑ר גַּם הַצֹּ֤אן וְהַבָּקָר֙ אַל יִרְע֔וּ אֶל מ֖וּל הָהָ֥ר הַהֽוּא

verses.restored: Moses carved two tablets of stone like the first; he rose early in morning and went up to Mount Sinai, as YHWH commanded him, and took in his hand two tablets of stone.

familiar.text: And he hewed two tables of stone like unto the first; and Moses rose up early in the morning, and went up unto mount Sinai, as the LORD had commanded him, and took in his hand the two tables of stone.

modern.text: So Moses chiseled out two stone tablets like the originals. He rose early in the morning, and taking the two stone tablets in his hands, he went up Mount Sinai as the LORD had commanded him.

original.text: וַיִּפְסֹ֡ל שְׁנֵֽי לֻחֹ֨ת אֲבָנִ֜ים כָּרִאשֹׁנִ֗ים וַיַּשְׁכֵּ֨ם מֹשֶׁ֤ה בַבֹּ֨קֶר֙ וַיַּ֨עַל֙ אֶל הַ֣ר סִינַ֔י כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֹת֑וֹ וַיִּקַּ֣ח בְּיָד֔וֹ שְׁנֵ֖י לֻחֹ֥ת אֲבָנִֽים

verses.restored: YHWH descended in cloud and stationed himself with him there, and called in name YHWH.

familiar.text: And the LORD descended in the cloud, and stood with him there, and proclaimed the name of the LORD.

modern.text: And the LORD descended in a cloud, stood with him there, and proclaimed His name, the LORD.

original.text: וַיֵּ֤רֶד יְהוָה֙ בֶּֽעָנָ֔ן וַיִּתְיַצֵּ֥ב עִמּ֖וֹ שָׁ֑ם וַיִּקְרָ֥א בְשֵׁ֖ם יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: YHWH passed before his face and called: YHWH, YHWH, Divine compassionate and gracious, slow to anger, abundant in loyal love and faithfulness/truth,

familiar.text: And the LORD passed by before him, and proclaimed, The LORD, The LORD God, merciful and gracious, longsuffering, and abundant in goodness and truth,

modern.text: Then the LORD passed in front of Moses and called out: “The LORD, the LORD God, is compassionate and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion and faithfulness,

original.text: וַיַּעֲבֹ֨ר יְהוָ֥ה עַל פָּנָיו֮ וַיִּקְרָא֒ יְהוָ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה אֵ֥ל רַח֖וּם וְחַנּ֑וּן אֶ֥רֶךְ אַפַּ֖יִם וְרַב חֶ֥סֶד וֶאֱמֶֽת

verses.restored: keeping loyal love to thousands, lifting/carrying iniquity, transgression, and sin/misalignment, yet clearing, he does not clear, visiting iniquity of fathers upon children and children's children to third and fourth.

familiar.text: Keeping mercy for thousands, forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin, and that will by no means clear the guilty; visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, and upon the children’s children, unto the third and to the fourth generation.

modern.text: maintaining loving devotion to a thousand generations, forgiving iniquity, transgression, and sin. Yet He will by no means leave the guilty unpunished; He will visit the iniquity of the fathers on their children and grandchildren to the third and fourth generations.”

original.text: נֹצֵ֥ר חֶ֨סֶד֙ לָאֲלָפִ֔ים נֹשֵׂ֥א עָוֺ֛ן וָפֶ֖שַׁע וְחַטָּאָ֑ה וְנַקֵּה֙ לֹ֣א יְנַקֶּ֔ה פֹּקֵ֣ד עֲוֺ֣ן אָב֗וֹת עַל בָּנִים֙ וְעַל בְּנֵ֣י בָנִ֔ים עַל שִׁלֵּשִׁ֖ים וְעַל רִבֵּעִֽים

verses.restored: Moses hurried, bowed low to earth, and worshiped.

familiar.text: And Moses made haste, and bowed his head toward the earth, and worshipped.

modern.text: Moses immediately bowed down to the ground and worshiped.

original.text: וַיְמַהֵ֖ר מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַיִּקֹּ֥ד אַ֖רְצָה וַיִּשְׁתָּֽחוּ

verses.restored: He said, If now I have found favor in your eyes, my Lord, please let my Lord go in our midst, for it is stiff-necked people; and forgive/lift our iniquity and our sin/misalignment, and take us as inheritance.

familiar.text: And he said, If now I have found grace in thy sight, O LORD, let my LORD, I pray thee, go among us; for it is a stiffnecked people; and pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for thine inheritance.

modern.text: “O Lord,” he said, “if I have indeed found favor in Your sight, my Lord, please go with us. Although this is a stiff-necked people, forgive our iniquity and sin, and take us as Your inheritance.” The LORD Renews the Covenant (2 Corinthians 3:7–18)

original.text: וַיֹּ֡אמֶר אִם נָא֩ מָצָ֨אתִי חֵ֤ן בְּעֵינֶ֨יךָ֙ אֲדֹנָ֔י יֵֽלֶךְ נָ֥א אֲדֹנָ֖י בְּקִרְבֵּ֑נוּ כִּ֤י עַם קְשֵׁה עֹ֨רֶף֙ ה֔וּא וְסָלַחְתָּ֛ לַעֲוֺנֵ֥נוּ וּלְחַטָּאתֵ֖נוּ וּנְחַלְתָּֽנוּ

verses.restored: He said, Look, I am cutting covenant. Before all your people I will do wonders that have not been created in all earth and in all nations; all the people in whose midst you are shall see work of YHWH, for it is fearsome what I am doing with you.

familiar.text: And he said, Behold, I make a covenant: before all thy people I will do marvels, such as have not been done in all the earth, nor in any nation: and all the people among which thou art shall see the work of the LORD: for it is a terrible thing that I will do with thee.

modern.text: And the LORD said, “Behold, I am making a covenant. Before all your people I will perform wonders that have never been done in any nation in all the world. All the people among whom you live will see the LORD’s work, for it is an awesome thing that I am doing with you.

original.text: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הִנֵּ֣ה אָנֹכִי֮ כֹּרֵ֣ת בְּרִית֒ נֶ֤גֶד כָּֽל עַמְּךָ֙ אֶעֱשֶׂ֣ה נִפְלָאֹ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹֽא נִבְרְא֥וּ בְכָל הָאָ֖רֶץ וּבְכָל הַגּוֹיִ֑ם וְרָאָ֣ה כָל הָ֠עָם אֲשֶׁר אַתָּ֨ה בְקִרְבּ֜וֹ אֶת מַעֲשֵׂ֤ה יְהוָה֙ כִּֽי נוֹרָ֣א ה֔וּא אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֖י עֹשֶׂ֥ה עִמָּֽךְ

verses.restored: Keep for yourself what I command you today. Look, I am driving out from before you Amorite, Canaanite, Hittite, Perizzite, Hivite, and Jebusite.

familiar.text: Observe thou that which I command thee this day: behold, I drive out before thee the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite.

modern.text: Observe what I command you this day. I will drive out before you the Amorites, Canaanites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.

original.text: שְׁמָ֨ר לְךָ֔ אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י מְצַוְּךָ֣ הַיּ֑וֹם הִנְנִ֧י גֹרֵ֣שׁ מִפָּנֶ֗יךָ אֶת הָאֱמֹרִי֙ וְהַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֔י וְהַחִתִּי֙ וְהַפְּרִזִּ֔י וְהַחִוִּ֖י וְהַיְבוּסִֽי

verses.restored: Guard yourself lest you cut covenant with inhabitant of land where you are coming, lest it become snare in your midst.

familiar.text: Take heed to thyself, lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land whither thou goest, lest it be for a snare in the midst of thee:

modern.text: Be careful not to make a treaty with the inhabitants of the land you are entering, lest they become a snare in your midst.

original.text: הִשָּׁ֣מֶר לְךָ֗ פֶּן תִּכְרֹ֤ת בְּרִית֙ לְיוֹשֵׁ֣ב הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתָּ֖ה בָּ֣א עָלֶ֑יהָ פֶּן יִהְיֶ֥ה לְמוֹקֵ֖שׁ בְּקִרְבֶּֽךָ

verses.restored: But their altars you shall tear down, their standing stones shatter, and their Asherim cut down.

familiar.text: But ye shall destroy their altars, break their images, and cut down their groves:

modern.text: Rather, you must tear down their altars, smash their sacred stones, and chop down their Asherah poles.

original.text: כִּ֤י אֶת מִזְבְּחֹתָם֙ תִּתֹּצ֔וּן וְאֶת מַצֵּבֹתָ֖ם תְּשַׁבֵּר֑וּן וְאֶת אֲשֵׁרָ֖יו תִּכְרֹתֽוּן

verses.restored: For you shall not bow to another god, for YHWH, whose name is Jealous, is jealous Divine.

familiar.text: For thou shalt worship no other god: for the LORD, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God:

modern.text: For you must not worship any other god, for the LORD, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God.

original.text: כִּ֛י לֹ֥א תִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֖ה לְאֵ֣ל אַחֵ֑ר כִּ֤י יְהוָה֙ קַנָּ֣א שְׁמ֔וֹ אֵ֥ל קַנָּ֖א הֽוּא

verses.restored: Lest you cut covenant with inhabitant of land, and they prostitute after their gods and sacrifice to their gods, and one call to you and you eat from his sacrifice,

familiar.text: Lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, and they go a whoring after their gods, and do sacrifice unto their gods, and one call thee, and thou eat of his sacrifice;

modern.text: Do not make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, for when they prostitute themselves to their gods and sacrifice to them, they will invite you, and you will eat their sacrifices.

original.text: פֶּן תִּכְרֹ֥ת בְּרִ֖ית לְיוֹשֵׁ֣ב הָאָ֑רֶץ וְזָנ֣וּ אַחֲרֵ֣י אֱלֹֽהֵיהֶ֗ם וְזָבְחוּ֙ לֵאלֹ֣הֵיהֶ֔ם וְקָרָ֣א לְךָ֔ וְאָכַלְתָּ֖ מִזִּבְחֽוֹ

verses.restored: and you take from his daughters for your sons, and his daughters prostitute after their gods and make your sons prostitute after their gods.

familiar.text: And thou take of their daughters unto thy sons, and their daughters go a whoring after their gods, and make thy sons go a whoring after their gods.

modern.text: And when you take some of their daughters as brides for your sons, their daughters will prostitute themselves to their gods and cause your sons to do the same.

original.text: וְלָקַחְתָּ֥ מִבְּנֹתָ֖יו לְבָנֶ֑יךָ וְזָנ֣וּ בְנֹתָ֗יו אַחֲרֵי֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵיהֶ֔ן וְהִזְנוּ֙ אֶת בָּנֶ֔יךָ אַחֲרֵ֖י אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽן

verses.restored: Molten gods you shall not make for yourself.

familiar.text: Thou shalt make thee no molten gods.

modern.text: You shall make no molten gods for yourselves.

original.text: אֱלֹהֵ֥י מַסֵּכָ֖ה לֹ֥א תַעֲשֶׂה לָּֽךְ

verses.restored: Festival of Unleavened Bread you shall keep: seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, at appointed time of month Aviv, for in month Aviv you went out from Egypt.

familiar.text: The feast of unleavened bread shalt thou keep. Seven days thou shalt eat unleavened bread, as I commanded thee, in the time of the month Abib: for in the month Abib thou camest out from Egypt.

modern.text: You are to keep the Feast of Unleavened Bread. For seven days at the appointed time in the month of Abib, you are to eat unleavened bread as I commanded you. For in the month of Abib you came out of Egypt.

original.text: אֶת חַ֣ג הַמַּצּוֹת֮ תִּשְׁמֹר֒ שִׁבְעַ֨ת יָמִ֜ים תֹּאכַ֤ל מַצּוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוִּיתִ֔ךָ לְמוֹעֵ֖ד חֹ֣דֶשׁ הָאָבִ֑יב כִּ֚י בְּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָֽאָבִ֔יב יָצָ֖אתָ מִמִּצְרָֽיִם

verses.restored: Every opener of womb is mine, and every male livestock, opener from ox and sheep.

familiar.text: All that openeth the matrix is mine; and every firstling among thy cattle, whether ox or sheep, that is male.

modern.text: The first offspring of every womb belongs to Me, including all the firstborn males among your livestock, whether cattle or sheep.

original.text: כָּל פֶּ֥טֶר רֶ֖חֶם לִ֑י וְכָֽל מִקְנְךָ֙ תִּזָּכָ֔ר פֶּ֖טֶר שׁ֥וֹר וָשֶֽׂה

verses.restored: Opener of donkey you shall redeem with lamb; if you do not redeem, break its neck. Every firstborn of your sons you shall redeem. None shall appear before my face empty.

familiar.text: But the firstling of an ass thou shalt redeem with a lamb: and if thou redeem him not, then shalt thou break his neck. All the firstborn of thy sons thou shalt redeem. And none shall appear before me empty.

modern.text: You must redeem the firstborn of a donkey with a lamb; but if you do not redeem it, you are to break its neck. You must redeem all the firstborn of your sons. No one shall appear before Me empty-handed.

original.text: וּפֶ֤טֶר חֲמוֹר֙ תִּפְדֶּ֣ה בְשֶׂ֔ה וְאִם לֹ֥א תִפְדֶּ֖ה וַעֲרַפְתּ֑וֹ כֹּ֣ל בְּכ֤וֹר בָּנֶ֨יךָ֙ תִּפְדֶּ֔ה וְלֹֽא יֵרָא֥וּ פָנַ֖י רֵיקָֽם

verses.restored: Six days you shall work, and on seventh day cease; in plowing and harvest you shall cease.

familiar.text: Six days thou shalt work, but on the seventh day thou shalt rest: in earing time and in harvest thou shalt rest.

modern.text: Six days you shall labor, but on the seventh day you shall rest; even in the seasons of plowing and harvesting, you must rest.

original.text: שֵׁ֤שֶׁת יָמִים֙ תַּעֲבֹ֔ד וּבַיּ֥וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֖י תִּשְׁבֹּ֑ת בֶּחָרִ֥ישׁ וּבַקָּצִ֖יר תִּשְׁבֹּֽת

verses.restored: Festival of Weeks you shall make for yourself, firstfruits of wheat harvest, and Festival of Ingathering at turning of year.

familiar.text: And thou shalt observe the feast of weeks, of the firstfruits of wheat harvest, and the feast of ingathering at the year’s end.

modern.text: And you are to celebrate the Feast of Weeks with the firstfruits of the wheat harvest, and the Feast of Ingathering at the turn of the year.

original.text: וְחַ֤ג שָׁבֻעֹת֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה לְךָ֔ בִּכּוּרֵ֖י קְצִ֣יר חִטִּ֑ים וְחַג֙ הָֽאָסִ֔יף תְּקוּפַ֖ת הַשָּׁנָֽה

verses.restored: Three times in year all your males shall appear before face of Lord YHWH, Divine of Israel.

familiar.text: Thrice in the year shall all your menchildren appear before the LORD God, the God of Israel.

modern.text: Three times a year all your males are to appear before the Lord GOD, the God of Israel.

original.text: שָׁלֹ֥שׁ פְּעָמִ֖ים בַּשָּׁנָ֑ה יֵרָאֶה֙ כָּל זְכ֣וּרְךָ֔ אֶת פְּנֵ֛י הָֽאָדֹ֥ן יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: For I will dispossess nations from before you and broaden your border; no one shall covet your land when you go up to appear before face of YHWH your Divine three times in year.

familiar.text: For I will cast out the nations before thee, and enlarge thy borders: neither shall any man desire thy land, when thou shalt go up to appear before the LORD thy God thrice in the year.

modern.text: For I will drive out the nations before you and enlarge your borders, and no one will covet your land when you go up three times a year to appear before the LORD your God.

original.text: כִּֽי אוֹרִ֤ישׁ גּוֹיִם֙ מִפָּנֶ֔יךָ וְהִרְחַבְתִּ֖י אֶת גְּבוּלֶ֑ךָ וְלֹא יַחְמֹ֥ד אִישׁ֙ אֶֽת אַרְצְךָ֔ בַּעֲלֹֽתְךָ֗ לֵרָאוֹת֙ אֶת פְּנֵי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ שָׁלֹ֥שׁ פְּעָמִ֖ים בַּשָּׁנָֽה

verses.restored: You shall not slaughter blood/life of my sacrifice with leaven; sacrifice of Festival of Passover shall not remain overnight until morning.

familiar.text: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leaven; neither shall the sacrifice of the feast of the passover be left unto the morning.

modern.text: Do not offer the blood of a sacrifice to Me along with anything leavened, and do not let any of the sacrifice from the Passover Feast remain until morning.

original.text: לֹֽא תִשְׁחַ֥ט עַל חָמֵ֖ץ דַּם זִבְחִ֑י וְלֹא יָלִ֣ין לַבֹּ֔קֶר זֶ֖בַח חַ֥ג הַפָּֽסַח

verses.restored: Beginning of firstfruits of your ground you shall bring to house of YHWH your Divine. You shall not boil a kid in milk of its mother.

familiar.text: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring unto the house of the LORD thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother’s milk.

modern.text: Bring the best of the firstfruits of your soil to the house of the LORD your God. You must not cook a young goat in its mother’s milk.”

original.text: רֵאשִׁ֗ית בִּכּוּרֵי֙ אַדְמָ֣תְךָ֔ תָּבִ֕יא בֵּ֖ית יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ לֹא תְבַשֵּׁ֥ל גְּדִ֖י בַּחֲלֵ֥ב אִמּֽוֹ

verses.restored: YHWH said to Moses, Write for yourself these words, for according to mouth of these words I cut covenant with you and with Israel.

familiar.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Write thou these words: for after the tenor of these words I have made a covenant with thee and with Israel.

modern.text: The LORD also said to Moses, “Write down these words, for in accordance with these words I have made a covenant with you and with Israel.”

original.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֔ה כְּתָב לְךָ֖ אֶת הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה כִּ֞י עַל פִּ֣י הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֗לֶּה כָּרַ֧תִּי אִתְּךָ֛ בְּרִ֖ית וְאֶת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: He was there with YHWH forty days and forty nights; bread he did not eat and water he did not drink. He wrote upon tablets words of covenant, the ten words.

familiar.text: And he was there with the LORD forty days and forty nights; he did neither eat bread, nor drink water. And he wrote upon the tables the words of the covenant, the ten commandments.

modern.text: So Moses was there with the LORD forty days and forty nights without eating bread or drinking water. He wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant—the Ten Commandments.

original.text: וַֽיְהִי שָׁ֣ם עִם יְהוָ֗ה אַרְבָּעִ֥ים יוֹם֙ וְאַרְבָּעִ֣ים לַ֔יְלָה לֶ֚חֶם לֹ֣א אָכַ֔ל וּמַ֖יִם לֹ֣א שָׁתָ֑ה וַיִּכְתֹּ֣ב עַל הַלֻּחֹ֗ת אֵ֚ת דִּבְרֵ֣י הַבְּרִ֔ית עֲשֶׂ֖רֶת הַדְּבָרִֽים

verses.restored: It happened when Moses descended from Mount Sinai, and two tablets of testimony were in Moses' hand as he descended from mountain, Moses did not know that skin of his face shone because he had spoken with him.

familiar.text: And it came to pass, when Moses came down from mount Sinai with the two tables of testimony in Moses’ hand, when he came down from the mount, that Moses wist not that the skin of his face shone while he talked with him.

modern.text: And when Moses came down from Mount Sinai with the two tablets of the Testimony in his hands, he was unaware that his face had become radiant from speaking with the LORD.

original.text: וַיְהִ֗י בְּרֶ֤דֶת מֹשֶׁה֙ מֵהַ֣ר סִינַ֔י וּשְׁנֵ֨י לֻחֹ֤ת הָֽעֵדֻת֙ בְּיַד מֹשֶׁ֔ה בְּרִדְתּ֖וֹ מִן הָהָ֑ר וּמֹשֶׁ֣ה לֹֽא יָדַ֗ע כִּ֥י קָרַ֛ן ע֥וֹר פָּנָ֖יו בְּדַבְּר֥וֹ אִתּֽוֹ

verses.restored: Aaron and all children of Israel saw Moses, and look, skin of his face shone, and they feared coming near him.

familiar.text: And when Aaron and all the children of Israel saw Moses, behold, the skin of his face shone; and they were afraid to come nigh him.

modern.text: Aaron and all the Israelites looked at Moses, and behold, his face was radiant. And they were afraid to approach him.

original.text: וַיַּ֨רְא אַהֲרֹ֜ן וְכָל בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶת מֹשֶׁ֔ה וְהִנֵּ֥ה קָרַ֖ן ע֣וֹר פָּנָ֑יו וַיִּֽירְא֖וּ מִגֶּ֥שֶׁת אֵלָֽיו

verses.restored: Moses called to them, and Aaron and all leaders in congregation returned to him, and Moses spoke to them.

familiar.text: And Moses called unto them; and Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation returned unto him: and Moses talked with them.

modern.text: But Moses called out to them; so Aaron and all the leaders of the congregation returned to him, and Moses spoke to them.

original.text: וַיִּקְרָ֤א אֲלֵהֶם֙ מֹשֶׁ֔ה וַיָּשֻׁ֧בוּ אֵלָ֛יו אַהֲרֹ֥ן וְכָל הַנְּשִׂאִ֖ים בָּעֵדָ֑ה וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֲלֵהֶֽם

verses.restored: Afterward all children of Israel came near, and he commanded them all that YHWH had spoken with him on Mount Sinai.

familiar.text: And afterward all the children of Israel came nigh: and he gave them in commandment all that the LORD had spoken with him in mount Sinai.

modern.text: And after this all the Israelites came near, and Moses commanded them to do everything that the LORD had told him on Mount Sinai.

original.text: וְאַחֲרֵי כֵ֥ן נִגְּשׁ֖וּ כָּל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיְצַוֵּ֕ם אֵת֩ כָּל אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אִתּ֖וֹ בְּהַ֥ר סִינָֽי

verses.restored: When Moses finished speaking with them, he put a veil over his face.

familiar.text: And till Moses had done speaking with them, he put a vail on his face.

modern.text: When Moses had finished speaking with them, he put a veil over his face.

original.text: וַיְכַ֣ל מֹשֶׁ֔ה מִדַּבֵּ֖ר אִתָּ֑ם וַיִּתֵּ֥ן עַל פָּנָ֖יו מַסְוֶֽה

verses.restored: When Moses came before YHWH to speak with him, he removed veil until he went out; then he went out and spoke to children of Israel what he was commanded.

familiar.text: But when Moses went in before the LORD to speak with him, he took the vail off, until he came out. And he came out, and spake unto the children of Israel that which he was commanded.

modern.text: But whenever Moses went in before the LORD to speak with Him, he would remove the veil until he came out. And when he came out, he would tell the Israelites what he had been commanded,

original.text: וּבְבֹ֨א מֹשֶׁ֜ה לִפְנֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ לְדַבֵּ֣ר אִתּ֔וֹ יָסִ֥יר אֶת הַמַּסְוֶ֖ה עַד צֵאת֑וֹ וְיָצָ֗א וְדִבֶּר֙ אֶל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֵ֖ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְצֻוֶּֽה

verses.restored: Children of Israel saw face of Moses, that skin of Moses' face shone; Moses returned veil over his face until he went in to speak with him.

familiar.text: And the children of Israel saw the face of Moses, that the skin of Moses’ face shone: and Moses put the vail upon his face again, until he went in to speak with him.

modern.text: and the Israelites would see that the face of Moses was radiant. So Moses would put the veil back over his face until he went in to speak with the LORD.

original.text: וְרָא֤וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶת פְּנֵ֣י מֹשֶׁ֔ה כִּ֣י קָרַ֔ן ע֖וֹר פְּנֵ֣י מֹשֶׁ֑ה וְהֵשִׁ֨יב מֹשֶׁ֤ה אֶת הַמַּסְוֶה֙ עַל פָּנָ֔יו עַד בֹּא֖וֹ לְדַבֵּ֥ר אִתּֽוֹ

translation_notes: Exodus 34:6-7 is a central YHWH character proclamation: compassionate, gracious, slow to anger, abundant loyal love and faithfulness, yet not ignoring injustice.
Moses immediately applies the proclamation by asking YHWH to go in their midst and forgive/lift sin.
Renewed covenant repeats anti-idolatry, festivals, firstborn redemption, Sabbath, firstfruits, and Passover memory after calf rupture.
Land/dispossession language remains source-preserved and ethically flagged.
Moses' shining face from speaking with YHWH should be preserved; later veil reception history requires careful audit.
safety_note: YHWH's mercy proclamation must not erase accountability, and accountability must not erase mercy. Land and anti-idolatry commands must not be used to justify modern violence or dispossession.
